nvidia.focus: Simulation infrastructure · synthetic sensors · world models
nvidia.edge: A connected GPU stack spanning robotics simulation, data generation and learned world models.
nvidia.summary: Connects GPU robotics simulation, synthetic sensor data, policy learning and open world models into a physical AI development stack.

applied-intuition.focus: Autonomy validation · neural reconstruction · vehicle software
applied-intuition.edge: Driving logs become virtual test environments inside a broader vehicle development and validation stack.
applied-intuition.summary: Builds autonomy simulation and vehicle software, with neural reconstruction turning fleet logs into virtual test environments.

parallel-domain.edge: Reconstructs logged environments to test perception against synchronized, controllable synthetic sensor views.
parallel-domain.summary: Reconstructs fleet environments and generates synchronized synthetic sensor data for perception training and autonomy regression tests.

bifrost.focus: Rare perception conditions · maritime · simulation evaluation
bifrost.edge: Targets hard-to-collect sensing conditions and extends synthetic-data workflows into policy evaluation.
bifrost.summary: Generates labeled maritime, aerial and geospatial sensor datasets, with a newer product evaluating robot policies in simulation.

world-labs.focus: Persistent 3D generation · spatial representation · world APIs
world-labs.edge: Persistent explorable 3D worlds, with shipping creator tools and a separate research path toward dynamics.
world-labs.summary: Generates persistent explorable 3D worlds from text, images and videos, with public Marble tools and a newer Atlas research model.

odyssey.focus: Action-conditioned dynamics · multi-agent worlds · policy learning
odyssey.edge: Live interactive prediction, shared worlds and model-based policy learning form one research trajectory.
odyssey.summary: Develops action-conditioned models for live interaction, shared multi-agent worlds and learning policies for virtual and physical systems.

waabi.focus: Closed-loop driving simulation · neural sensors · trucking
waabi.edge: An integrated autonomy-and-simulator loop grounded in driving logs, controllable scenarios and sensor models.
waabi.summary: Builds autonomous driving around Waabi World, a learned simulator of roads, sensors and traffic for closed-loop training and evaluation.

general-intuition.focus: Gameplay actions · multi-agent prediction · agent learning
general-intuition.edge: Action-labeled gameplay at scale, with an open multiplayer dynamics model to test shared-world consistency.
general-intuition.summary: Builds world and action models from gameplay, combining Medal data with open research on action-conditioned multiplayer dynamics.

physicsx.focus: Engineering prediction · design optimization · physics AI
physicsx.edge: Engineering simulation becomes a data engine for fast geometry-conditioned prediction and optimization.
physicsx.summary: Trains models on engineering simulations and experiments to predict performance quickly and explore industrial hardware designs.

duality-ai.focus: System-specific simulation · digital environments · sensor data
duality-ai.edge: Combines configurable environments, sensors and system behavior into autonomy test and data-generation loops.
duality-ai.summary: Builds Falcon, a configurable digital-twin simulator for synthetic sensor data and autonomy testing with system-specific physics.

cognite.focus: Industrial data context · asset graphs · operational workflows
cognite.edge: Contextualized industrial data gives operational twins a trustworthy connection to assets and measurements.
cognite.summary: Connects sensor, engineering and enterprise data into asset models for maintenance, operational digital twins and industrial AI.

wandelbots.focus: Robot software · virtual controllers · industrial cells
wandelbots.edge: Robot-independent software connects simulated cells, virtual controllers and physical industrial robots.
wandelbots.summary: Builds robot-independent software connecting virtual controllers, simulation, motion planning and physical industrial robot cells.
